prompt: What does a double arrow sign mean?
bankAnswer: Traffic may pass on either side of obstruction

decisions.prompt: The road splits around an island with this sign on it. You are in the left lane, with a car beside you. What do you do?
decisions.signAlt: A yellow diamond sign with two black arrows pointing down and apart

correctAction.label: Stay in my lane and pass on the left

wrongActions.label: Move right: I must keep right of the island
wrongActions.consequence: You cut into the lane beside you for no reason. The other driver had to brake and swerve to miss you.

wrongActions.label: Stop before the island
wrongActions.consequence: You stopped in a moving lane. The driver behind had to brake hard and swerve around you.

successText: You held your lane and passed on the left while the car beside you passed on the right. Both sides were open, which is all the sign says.
ruleText: A double arrow sign means traffic may pass on either side of the island or obstruction, so stay in your lane and keep moving.

citation.source: FHWA Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices, 11th Edition

verified: Read in the FHWA PDF, Nov 2026: the sign advises "that traffic is permitted to pass on either side of an island, obstruction, or gore in the roadway".
